serp.note: ~2,500 words. ClickUp Unlimited $7, Business $12; Asana Starter $10.99, Advanced $24.99. Says ClickUp Free is more generous for teams under 3 but gives no seat-band math. Monday-branded blog so lightly pivots to Monday as third option.
ClickUp's own blog. Still lists Unlimited $7 and Business $12 (older naming) alongside Brain AI $9 add-on. Advertises ClickUp strengths; useful for feature-list verification but biased on verdicts.
Short comparison. Confirms ClickUp Unlimited starts at $7, Asana Premium at $10.99, AI bundled on Asana vs $9 add-on on ClickUp. Learning curve: Asana shorter, ClickUp steeper.

Agency consultancy post. Recommends Asana for 5-person team running simple projects, ClickUp for ops-heavy agencies. Pricing matrix: ClickUp $7/$12, Asana $10.99/$24.99. Says Asana Free limited to 15 members (contradicts pricing-page capture of 2 members).
'Save $300' angle. Confirms Asana sells seats with a minimum (defaults to 5 seats without clear notice), per the author. Cites Starter $10.99 2-seat minimum, Advanced $24.99.
~2,500 words. Pricing table ClickUp Unlimited $7, Business $12 vs Asana Starter $10.99, Advanced $24.99. Does not surface seat-band billing specifics; feature matrix is useful.

Strongest source for seat-band math. Explicitly says 'Asana steps of 1 up to 5, then steps of 5 up to 30. monday minimum 3 seats, then buckets of 5.' Priced 12-person team: Asana Starter $164.85/mo = $1,978/yr vs ClickUp Core $108/mo = $1,296/yr.
Three-way comparison. Confirms Asana native time tracking requires Advanced $24.99, ClickUp Core includes it at $7. Recommends by priority: Asana for UX, ClickUp for value, monday for visuals.

'$1,559 more per year' angle. Priced ClickUp Business ($12 × 10 users × 12 = $1,440/yr) vs Asana Advanced ($24.99 × 10 × 12 = $2,999/yr) = $1,559 gap. Also notes ClickUp Free includes 100 automations/mo. Recommends 2-week parallel pilot.

Flags the Unlimited→Core rename: 'ClickUp: $7 (classic Unlimited) or $9 (new Core).' Confirms Asana Personal 2 users, ClickUp Free 60MB, Brain AI $9 add-on as of Oct 22 2026. Most up-to-date source on the pricing transition.
